main_issue: Whether alcohol can be kept and served in the flat for the housewarming, given D's objection; resolved by keeping drinks in a cooler outside the front door.

A-B.evidence: B said 'looks good' (T2) and A bought the drinks; both later accept the cooler outside (T17, T19).

A-C.evidence: C proposed the cooler (T13) and asked A (T15); A: 'a cooler outside works for me' (T17).

A-D.evidence: A questioned D's objection (T8); D agreed to the cooler outside (T14); A accepted it (T17) and said 'settled' (T21).

B-C.evidence: C asked B whether the cooler works for the manager (T18); B said it works (T19) and thanked C.

B-D.evidence: B needed drinks available (T10), D objected to alcohol (T9); both end up accepting the cooler outside (T14, T19).

C-D.evidence: C offered the kitchen idea (D declined, T12) then the cooler outside; D: 'I can agree to that. Thanks, Agent C' (T14).
